verses.sanskrit: वैशम्पायन उवाच । स शत्रुसेनां तरसा प्रणुद्य गास्ता विजित्याथ धनुर्धराग्र्यः । दुर्योधनायाभिमुखं प्रयातो भूयो रणं सोऽभिचिकीर्षमाणः ॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Having quickly routed the enemy's host and recovered the kine, that foremost of bowmen, with a view to fight again, proceeded towards Duryodhana.

verses.sanskrit: गोषु प्रयातासु जवेन मत्स्यान् किरीटिनं कृतकार्यं च मत्वा । दुर्योधनायाभिमुखं प्रयातं कुरुप्रवीराः सहसा निपेतुः ॥२॥
verses.english: Seeing the kine run towards the city of Matsya's and considering Kiritin successful, the heroic Kurus all on a sudden withstood him who was proceeding towards Duryodhana.

verses.sanskrit: तेषामनीकानि बहूनि गाढं व्यूढानि दृष्ट्वा बहुलध्वजानि । मत्स्यस्य पुत्रं द्विषतां निहन्ता वैराटिमामन्त्र्य ततोऽभ्युवाच ॥३॥
verses.english: Beholding their army and various well arranged divisions as well as numberless flags, that destroyer of enemies, addressing the son of Virata, the king of Matsya's, said,

verses.sanskrit: एतेन तूर्णं प्रतिपादयेमान् श्वेतान् हयान् काञ्चनरश्मियोक्त्रान् । जवेन सर्वेण कुरु प्रयत्नमासादयेऽहं कुरुसिंहवृन्दम् ॥४॥
verses.english: Soon take these white horses by this way, governed by golden reins. Do you quickly and carefully take me to the row of the leading Kuru heroes.

verses.sanskrit: गजो गजेनेव मया दुरात्मा योद्धुं समाकाङ्क्षति सूतपुत्रः । तमेव मां प्रापय राजपुत्र दुर्योधनापाश्रयजातदर्पम् ॥५॥
verses.english: The wicked-souled son of the charioteer (Karna) wishes to fight with me as an elephant does with another (elephant). Do you take me to him, O prince, who has grown insolent for the protection afforded to him by Duryodhana.
verses.bhavadeepa: एतेन पथा काञ्चनमया रश्मयो रज्जवस्ता एव योक्त्राणि बन्धनानि येषां तान् कुरुसिंहस्य दुर्योधनस्य वृन्दं मुख्यम् । बृहि वृद्धौ अस्मात् कप्रत्यये हस्य दः ॥४॥

verses.sanskrit: स तैर्हयैर्वातजवैर्बृहद्भिः पुत्रो विराटस्य सुवर्णकक्षैः । व्यध्वंसयत् तद्रथिनामनीकं ततोऽवहत् पाण्डवमाजिमध्ये ॥६॥
verses.english: Then breaking through the array of carwarriors with big horses fleet as the wind the son of Virata took Arjuna to the middle of the battle field.

verses.sanskrit: तं चित्रसेनो विशिखैर्विपाठैः सङ्ग्रामजिच्छत्रुसहो जयश्च । प्रत्युद्ययुर्भारतमापतन्तं महारथाः कर्णमभीप्समानाः ॥७॥
verses.english: Seeing this, those powerful car-warriors, Chitrasena, Sangramajit, Shatrusaha and Jaya with a view to help Karna, rushed towards the advancing Arjuna.
verses.bhavadeepa: सुवर्णकक्षैः स्वर्णमयौ कक्षौ पल्याणस्य पश्चादञ्चलपल्लवौ येषां तैः ‘कक्षः स्यादन्तरीयस्य पश्चादञ्चलपल्लवे’ इति मेदिनी ॥६॥

verses.sanskrit: ततः स तेषां पुरुषप्रवीरः शरासनार्चिः शरवेगतापः । व्रातं रथानामदहत् समन्युर्वनं यथाग्निः कुरुपुङ्गवानाम् ॥८॥
verses.english: Thereupon worked up with anger that foremost of men began to consume, with blazing shafts, discharged from his bow, the cars of the leading Kurus like fire consuming the forest.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस्तु युद्धे तुमुले प्रवृत्ते पार्थं विकर्णोऽतिरथं रथेन । विपाठवर्षेण कुरुप्रवीरो भीमेन भीमानुजमाससाद ॥९॥
verses.english: When the battle grew dreadful, Vikarana, a leading Kuru hero, getting upon his own chariot, moved towards that mighty carwarrior, Partha, the younger brother of Bhima with a dreadful downpour of shafts.

verses.sanskrit: ततो विकर्णस्य धनुर्विकृष्य जाम्बूनदाग्र्योपचितं दृढज्यम् । अपातयत् तं ध्वजमस्य मथ्य छिन्नध्वजः सोऽप्यपयाज्जवेन ॥१०॥
verses.english: Then cutting off his bow with a strong string and having its tops covered with gold he sundered-his Flag-staff. Then with his Flagstaff broken down he quickly took to heels.

verses.sanskrit: तं शात्रवाणां गणबाधितारं कर्माणि कुर्वन्तममानुषाणि । शत्रुंतपः पार्थममृष्यमाणः समार्दयच्छरवर्षेण पार्थम् ॥११॥
verses.english: Unable to check his anger, Shatruntapa, with a downpour of shafts, began to afflict Partha-the obstructor of the enemies and the author of superhuman deeds.
verses.bhavadeepa: विकृष्य विलिख्य छित्वेत्यर्थः अस्य तं प्रसिद्धं ध्वजं च मथ्य उन्मथ्यापातयत् अपयात् अपायात् ॥१०॥

verses.sanskrit: स तेन राज्ञाऽतिरथेन विद्धो विगाहमानो ध्वजिनीं कुरूणाम् । शत्रुंतपं पञ्चभिराशु विद्ध्वा ततोऽस्य सूतं दशभिर्जघान ॥१२॥
verses.english: Then wounded by that king a mighty carwarrior and drowned as it were in the Kuru army he wounded Shatruntapa with five arrows and then killed his charioteer with ten.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स विद्धो भरतर्षभेण बाणेन गात्रावरणातिगेन । गतासुराजौ निपपात भूमौ नगो नगाग्रादिव वातरुग्णः ॥१३॥
verses.english: Then wounded by that foremost of Bharatas with a greatly piercing shaft the king leaving his armour fell down dead on the ground like a rock from the mountain summit clapped by the wind.

verses.sanskrit: नरर्षभास्तेन नरर्षभेण वीरा रणे वीरतरेण भग्नाः । चकम्पिरे वातवशेन काले प्रकम्पितानीव महावनानि ॥१४॥
verses.english: Assailed by the foremost of men, a greater hero, those heroic leaders of the Kurus began to tremble in battle like a huge forest shaken by the wind at the time of the universal dissolution.
verses.bhavadeepa: नगो वृक्षः नगाग्रात् पर्वताग्रात् । ‘शैलवृक्षौ नगावगौ’ इत्यमरः ॥१३॥

verses.sanskrit: हतास्तु पार्थेन नरप्रवीरा गतासवोर्व्यां सुषुपुः सुवेषाः । वसुप्रदा वासवतुल्यवीर्याः पराजिता वासवजेन संख्ये ॥१५॥
verses.english: Vanquished in battle and slain by Partha, the son of Indra, those heroes, givers of wealth and endued with the prowess of Vasava and well-dressed, slept on the ground, deprived of their lives,

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णकार्ष्णायसवर्मनद्धा नागा यथा हैमवताः प्रवृद्धाः । तथा स शत्रून् समरे विनिघ्नन् गाण्डीवधन्वा पुरुषप्रवीरः ॥१६॥
verses.english: Like huge Himalaya elephants dressed with armours made of black steel decked with gold. Thus slaying his enemies in battle that heroic man, the holder of Gandiva bow,

verses.sanskrit: चचार संख्ये विदिशो दिशश्च दहन्निवाग्निर्वनमातपान्ते । प्रकीर्णपर्णानि यथा वसन्ते विशातयित्वा पवनोऽम्बुदांश्च ॥१७॥
verses.english: Began to move about in the field in all direction like fire consuming a forest at the end of summer. As the wind blows in the spring scattering the withered leaves and clouds.

verses.sanskrit: तथा सपत्नान् विकिरन् किरीटी चचार संख्येऽतिरथो रथेन । शोणाश्ववाहस्य हयान् निहत्य वैकर्तनभ्रातुरदीनसत्त्वः । एकेन सङ्ग्रामजितः शरेण शिरो जहाराथ किरीटमाली ॥१८॥
verses.english: So the mighty car-warrior Kiritin ranged in the battle field in his chariot dispersing his enemies. Then killing the horses of the brother of Vikartana's son, that one of undeteriorating energy. Ever victorious in battle and decked with a brilliant diadem, with one shaft, speedily cut off his head.
verses.bhavadeepa: आतपान्ते घर्मस्वरूपे निदाघे । ‘अन्तः स्वरूपे नाशे ना’ इति मेदिनी ॥१७॥

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् हते भ्रातरि सूतपुत्रो वैकर्तनो वीर्यमथाददानः । प्रगृह्य दन्ताविव नागराजो महर्षभं व्याघ्र इवाभ्यधावत् ॥१९॥
verses.english: His brother being slain, the son of Suta, Vikartana's son, gathering his energy. Rushed towards that foremost of men like an elephant chief, with the two tusks out or like a tiger. And Vikartana's son quickly wounded Arjuna with twelve arrows.
verses.bhavadeepa: शोणाश्वाः वाहे वाहके रथे यस्य तस्य ॥१८॥

verses.sanskrit: स पाण्डवं द्वादशभिः पृषत्कैर्वैकर्तनः शीघ्रमथो जघान । विव्याध गात्रेषु हयांश्च सर्वान् विराटपुत्रं च करे निजघ्ने ॥२०॥
verses.english: All the horses on their bodies, and the son of Virata on the hand. Furiously hastening towards Vikartana's son who was quickly proceeding towards him, Kiritin attacked him with great force like Garuda of variegated plumage falling upon snakes.
verses.bhavadeepa: आददान आदातुमिच्छन् प्रगृह्य आग्रहेण दन्ताविव पर्वतशिखरतुल्यौ अर्जुनोत्तरौ प्रति अभ्यधावत् । ‘दन्तः सानुनि कथ्यते’ इति विश्वः ‘दन्तोऽद्रिकटके कुञ्जे’ इति मेदिनी ॥१९॥

verses.sanskrit: तमापतन्तं सहसा किरीटी वैकर्तनं वे तरसाऽभिपत्य । प्रगृह्य वेगं न्यपतज्जवेन नागं गरुत्मानिव चित्रपक्षः ॥२१॥
तावुत्तमौ सर्वधनुर्धराणां महाबलौ सर्वसपत्नसाहौ । कर्णस्य पार्थस्य निशम्य युद्धं दिदृक्षमाणाः कुरवोऽमितस्थुः ॥२२॥
verses.english: Both of them were best of bowmen, were greatly powerful and capable of killing all enemies. Understanding that an encounter was soon to take place between Karna and Partha, the Kurus, wishing to witness it, stood at a distance.

verses.sanskrit: स पाण्डवस्तूर्णमुदीर्णकोपः कृतागसं कर्णमुदीक्ष्य हर्षात् । क्षणेन साध्वं सरथं ससारथिमन्तर्दधे घोरशरौघवृष्ट्या ॥२३॥
verses.english: Seeing the iniquitous Karna, Arjuna, excited with anger, in great pleasure, quickly made him, his horses and his charioteer invisible by a thick downpour of arrows.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सुविद्धाः सरथाः सनागा योधा विनेदुर्भरतर्षभाणाम् । अन्तर्हिता भीष्ममुखाः सहाश्वाः किरीटिना कीर्णरथाः पृषत्कैः ॥२४॥
verses.english: The warriors of the Bharatas, headed by Bhishma, with their horses, elephants and chariots rendered invisible and pierced and having their cars broken by Kiritin with shafts, began to bewail.

verses.sanskrit: वैशम्पायन उवाच । स चापि तानर्जुनबाहुमुक्तान् शरान् शरौघैः प्रतिहत्य वीरः । तस्थौ महात्मा सधनुः सबाणः सविस्फुलिङ्गोऽग्निरिवाशु कर्णः ॥२५॥
verses.english: Then baffaling with his own arrows those shot by the hands of Arjuna the hero, the highsouled Karna, all on a sudden came into view with his bow and arrow like fire with scintillations.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्वभूद्वै तलतालशब्दः सशङ्खभेरीपणवप्रणादः । प्रक्ष्वेडितज्यातलनिःस्वनं तं वैकर्तनं पूजयतां कुरूणाम् ॥२६॥
verses.english: Then there arose the sound of the clapping of hands and that of conchs, trumpets and bugles while the Kurus spoke highly of Vikartana's son who filled the welkin with the sound of his bow-string striking against his gloves.

verses.sanskrit: उद्धूतलाङ्गूलमहापताकध्वजोत्तमांसाकुलभीषणान्तम् । गाण्डीवनिह्रादकृतप्रणादं किरीटिनं प्रेक्ष्य ननाद कर्णः ॥२७॥
verses.english: Then seeing Kiritin fill the sky with the twang of his Gandiva bow, the upraised tail of the monkey that was on his Flag-staff and the dreadful creatures yelling hideously from the Flag-staff, Karna sent up a shout.
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रक्ष्वेडितो मुक्तो ज्यातलयोर्निस्वनो येन तं पूजयतां तलतालशब्दः तलेन चपेटया तालः करास्फालनं तज्जः शब्दोऽभूत् । ‘तलश्चपेटे तालद्रौ’ ‘तालः करास्फाले’ इति च मेदिनी ॥२६॥

verses.sanskrit: स चापि वैकर्तनमर्दयित्वा साश्वं ससूतं सरथं पृषत्कैः । तमाववर्ष प्रसभं किरीटी पितामहं द्रोणकृपौ च दृष्ट्वा ॥२८॥
verses.english: Then assailing with his arrows Vikartana's son, together with his horses, car and charioteer, Arjuna showered a downpour of shafts on him, casting his looks on Bhishma, Drona and Kripa Vikartana's son too covered Partha with a downpour of shafts like a cloud.
verses.bhavadeepa: उद्भूतमुपरिकृतं लाङ्गूलमेव महती पताका ध्वजाञ्चलो यस्मिंस्तस्य ध्वजस्य उत्तमौ असौ उपरिस्थतिर्यक्फलकाग्रभागौ तत्र आकुला व्यग्राः ये भीषणाः भूतादयः ते अन्ते समीपे यस्य तम् । गाण्डीवनिह्रादेन सह कृतः प्रणादो येन तं गाण्डीवनिह्रादकृतप्रणादं किरीटिनम् । ध्वजोपरिस्थभूतनादैः संवर्धितनादमित्यर्थः ॥२७॥

verses.sanskrit: स चापि पार्थं बहुभिः पृषत्कैर्वैकर्तनो मेघ इवाभ्यवर्षत् । तथैव कर्णं च किरीटमाली संछादयामास शितैः पृषत्कैः ॥२९॥
तयोः सुतीक्ष्णान् सृजतोः शरौघान् महाशरौघास्त्रविवर्धने रणे । रथे विलग्नाविव चन्द्रसूर्यौ घनान्तरेणानुददर्श लोकः ॥३०॥
verses.english: And he too, decked with a diadem, covered Karna with sharp arrows. Creating clouds of sharp arrows in a battle rendered furious by huge weapons and shafts.

verses.sanskrit: अथाशुकारी चतुरो हयांश्च विव्याध कर्णो निशितैः किरीटिनः । त्रिभिश्च यन्तारममृष्यमाणो विव्याध तूर्णं त्रिभिरस्य केतुम् ॥३१॥
verses.english: The two, stationed on cars, appeared to men like the sun and the moon covered by clouds. Then the light-handed and intelligent Karna wounded the horses of Partha with shafts,
verses.bhavadeepa: महद्भिः शरौघैरस्त्रोघैश्च विवर्धनं छेदनं यत्र तस्मिन्रणे बिलग्नौ संनिहितौ चन्द्रसूर्यौ घनमध्यादिव तौ बाणसंघमध्याल्लोकोऽनुददर्श ॥३०॥

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽभिविद्धः समरावमर्दी प्रबोधितः सिंह इव प्रसुप्तः । गाण्डीवधन्वा ऋषभः कुरूणामजिह्मगैः कर्णमियाय जिष्णुः ॥३२॥
verses.english: Assailed his driver with three arrows and struck down his Flag-staff with three. Thus struck like a sleeping lion awaking, that repressor of enemies in battle,

verses.sanskrit: शरास्त्रवृष्ट्या निहतो महात्मा प्रादुश्चकारातिमनुष्यकर्म । प्राच्छादयत् कर्णरथं पृषत्कैर्लोकानिमान् सूर्य इवांशुजालैः ॥३३॥
verses.english: The holder of Gandiva, the heroic Vishnu, assailed Karna with straight shafts, And assailed with a downpour of arrows and weapons the high-souled performer of superhuman deeds displayed (mighty feats).

verses.sanskrit: स हस्तिनेवाभिहतो गजेन्द्रः प्रगृह्य भल्लान् निशितान् निषङ्गात् । आकर्णपूर्णं च धनुर्विकृष्य विव्याध गात्रेष्वथ सूतपुत्रम् ॥३४॥
verses.english: He covered Karna's car with shafts like the sun covering the regions with its rays. Like a lion attacked by an elephant he, taking out sharpened arrows from the quiver.

verses.sanskrit: अथास्य बाहू‌रुशिरोललाटं ग्रीवां वराङ्गानि परावमर्दी । शितैश्च बाणैर्युधि निर्बिभेद गाण्डीवमुक्तैरशनिप्रकाशैः ॥३५॥
verses.english: And drawing the bow to his ear wounded the charioteer's son on every part of his body. Then that repressor of enemies pierced Karna's arms, thighs, head, forehead and other parts of his body with sharpened arrows fleet as the thunderbolt, shot from his Gandiva bow.

verses.sanskrit: स पार्थमुक्तैरिषुभिः प्रणुन्नो गजो गजेनेव जितस्तरस्वी । विहाय सङ्ग्रामशिरः प्रयातो वैकर्तनः पाण्डवबाणतप्तः ॥३६॥
verses.english: Thus wounded by the arrows shot by Partha, the son of Pandu, Vikartana's son lef the battle-field and took to his heels like a elephant defeated by another.
